pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I HEARD DEVILS CAN HEAL BY DRINKING BLOOD! YOU DON'T WANNA DIE THEN BITE ME!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I AIN'T RUNNIN' A CHARITY THOUGH...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I'LL HELP YOU... SO NOW YOU GOTTA HELP ME.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HOW'S ABOLT HIRIN' ME AS A DEVIL HUNTER?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: I CAN'T SLEEP, SO I KEEP THINKIN' ABOLT THE DEBT, WHICH JUST MAKES IT WORSE...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...I'VE DECIDED. IF I SLEEP TONIGHT, I'M GONNA DREAM ABOUT...
